Step: f(x) $$=$$ $$x^2$$

Hint 1: Consider the shape of the scatterplot. Does it resemble a quadratic curve, which is typically represented by a parabolic shape? If not, then f(x) $$=$$ $$x^2$$ might not be the correct function to fit the data.

Hint 2: Think about the effect of squaring the x-values. Squaring tends to emphasize larger values and create a symmetric curve. If the scatterplot does not show this kind of symmetry or curvature, then f(x) $$=$$ $$x^2$$ is likely not suitable.
